highLevelGoal: Make Orca crash-safe at its core unattended-execution boundaries: durable repository actor/process ownership across controller death, no second writer under live/unknown prior ownership, atomic/replayable dispatch-control-completion transitions, and bounded initialization/profile cleanup.

checkpoint.summary: Change 028 progress through 2026-08-27: foundation slices (migration 24, ProcessProbe, RepositoryActorLeaseService, controller instance id, direct-executor durable ownership) landed in e39ea83/c2aaef4/a1de7ab. F2 durable transition processor (OrchestrationTransitionService: one-transaction source-consume + run-mutation + outbox with post-commit replayable delivery) landed in e32db82 and wired into the direct-executor COMPLETED completion path (dispatch consume + Sol wake now crash-atomic); 5 transition tests green. Remote re-audit at 275154f (planner only) deep-scanned main@a1de7ab and recorded NEW P0 regressions in the landed foundation slice that partially reopen the F1 second-writer guarantee: WindowsProcessProbe.capture records no creation/executable identity while classify treats missing evidence as wildcard LIVE_MATCH; queryProcess collapses dead-PID and probe-failure into UNKNOWN; a prior STARTING/ACTIVE lease with zero process rows auto-releases (reopens spawn-before-persistence window); post-spawn ownership failure can re-enter generic launch retry and double-spawn; each retry reuses one process-row ID; exit observation is installed after the awaited onSpawn hook; all-pre-spawn launch failure can strand a STARTING lease. Tasks 1.7-1.11, 3.4-3.9, 4.6-4.10, 5.8-5.9 were added to close these. F2 transition atomicity remains active and complementary; both workstreams coexist.
checkpoint.lastCompletedTask: F2: implemented OrchestrationTransitionService (D7/D8/D9) and wired direct-executor dispatch completion through it (D9.1/D9.2); added test/transition-service.test.ts (5 tests). Reconciled with remote re-audit 275154f and merged its refined task list + P0 findings into the waypoint.
